reader_summary.headline: Our first guest on the Senior Decision Makers mini-series is Nick Csicsko.
reader_summary.overview: Our first guest on the Senior Decision Makers mini-series is Nick Csicsko. Nick is a Managing Director at the Trinity Wall Street endowment. Today the endowment has grown to over $6 billion. Nick's path into investing is a fascinating one.

key_points.text: Nick is a Managing Director at the Trinity Wall Street endowment.
He studied composition and earned his Doctorate of Music at Juilliard.
While there, he talked his way into an internship at Juilliard's endowment and never looked back.
